```ts
import { call, saga } from "zttp:workflow";
import { run } from "zttp:durable";

structural Guard<T> = Proof<T, "state_isolated">;

export function handler(req: Request): Guard<Response> {
  const key = req.headers.get("idempotency-key");
  if (key === undefined) {
    return Response.json({ error: "missing idempotency-key" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  return run(key, () => {
    const outcome = saga([
      {
        name: "reserve",
        run: () => call("inventory", { path: "/reserve", method: "POST" }),
        compensate: () => call("inventory", { path: "/release", method: "POST" })

        name: "charge",
        run: () => call("billing", { path: "/charge", method: "POST" }),

      {
        name: "ship",

      }

  });
}
```

```ts
import { run } from "zttp:durable";
```
